entries.message: Missing <main>: every page needs a main landmark.
entries.note: VitePress home layout: the hero and feature sections sit outside any landmark, so the page has no <main>. Not ours to fix in markup we do not author — the same finding is suppressed for / in the axe suite (ROUTE_DISABLED_RULES: landmark-one-main, region). Accepted here for the same reason, and in the same one place, so the two gates cannot disagree about what is known.
